review_type: AI source checking: targeted release temporality

summary.scope: Targeted release-temporality checking only, separate from the six-card random ICML 2026 audit and from full semantic review counts. Read the source units and card fields of both records to check for future release being represented as current availability. SECNet S9 says code will be available, and unknowns[2] explicitly preserves future availability and unestablished current status. GFG S8 also says code will be available, and unknowns[2] correctly calls it forthcoming. Neither card claims an already completed code release elsewhere.
summary.limitations: No live repository availability check was performed or required: the task checks faithful extraction of the supplied abstract's release statement. These two targeted passes do not constitute full semantic audits, experiment validation, or reproducibility verification. No cards were edited and no additional model calls were made.
